method.flashattention_frontend: minimal compatibility adapter to vllm.vllm_flash_attn.flash_attn_varlen_func (FA2); official Hydragen shared-prefix decomposition and LSE combiner remain unchanged; the released Triton-2 unique-KV kernel is not executed because it is incompatible with the frozen Triton 3.6 environment

port_boundary: The released Hydragen model wrapper is Llama-only, its pinned private flash_attn API is absent, and its dynamically unrolled Triton-2 unique-KV kernel does not compile under the frozen Triton 3.6 environment. The experiment therefore runs the official Hydragen shared-prefix decomposition and LSE-combination code while routing both attention subcalls through a hash-bound frontend onto vLLM's packaged FlashAttention-2 fork. This is an explicit operator port, not an unmodified official end-to-end implementation.
kernel_compatibility_geometry: The vLLM paged-FA2 ABI requires page sizes divisible by 16. Unique K/V already use 32-token pages. The replicated control is therefore physically zero-padded once from 4,127 to 4,128 tokens per row outside timed calls, while the logical per-request seqused_k values remain 4,099--4,127. The extra compatibility tail is excluded from the method-independent logical KV accounting.
